title: Separate public claims, execution and verified effects
description: A public reply can support a note about what the target said. It cannot by itself prove a tool executed or an objective was achieved. Keep hypotheses, partial progress and independently checked outcomes distinct.
when_to_try: Interpreting any response or choosing a follow-up after apparent progress.
prerequisites: Evidence provenance and a declared outcome check for the experiment.
limitations: This is a testing design principle, not an observed successful attack pattern.
Exact-quote validation establishes the source of a note, not the truth of its interpretation.

sources.note: The attacker uses public replies; operator verification stays outside planner feedback. References without a URL are relative to apps/attacker-agent.
